lb.role: C++ TCP/HTTP load balancer (Load-Balancer-CPP), systemd unit lb.service; data path on :8080, admin/stats JSON on :8081 (listen port + 1)
lb.config: lb.conf (port, backends, algo, threads, max_conn; SIGHUP reload)

echo-backends.role: three echo servers on :8001-:8003 started by the same unit as lb

lb-sandbox.role: Nightshift's own throwaway copy of the balancer (unit nsbox-lb.service, data :8090, admin :8091, backends :8093-:8095) used for fault injection; not customer traffic

host.role: the EC2 instance itself (2 vCPU, ~7.6 GB); node_exporter metrics

notes: Only black-box signals exist: HTTP/TCP probes of each port, host metrics, and journald logs. The app exports no metrics. Logs are plain text '[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] [LEVEL] msg' and journald buffers them, so the journal timestamp can lag the embedded time. Source code of the balancer is available through the code tools.
